title: Two γ-ray bursts from dusty regions with little molecular gas
question: Do GRB host galaxies with high SFR and metallicity contain molecular gas (CO) and dust at the burst sites, and what are the molecular gas-to-dust ratios?

what.value: Herschel 100, 160, 250 um photometry used in SED fit
Radio 3 cm and 6 cm upper limits

evidence.quote: the 3σ upper limits of S 3cm < 138 μJy and S 6cm < 33 μJy (ref. 45)

recipe.method: CASA reduction, CLEAN with Briggs weighting; continuum from line-free channels; CO velocity-integrated maps
L'CO from S dv, nu_obs, D_L; convert to CO(1-0) with M82 ratios; Mgas = alpha_CO L'CO(1-0)
